# meshterm-vulnfeed rpmver.match_compare / meshTerm RpmVersion.matchCompare (review M1): the comparison the matcher
# uses. Two MODULAR builds compare without the `+<module build id>+<context>` after `module[_+]elX.Y.Z`; anything else
# is the plain EVR order. Real NEVRAs (Red Hat's rhel-8 httpd:2.4 fixes, Rocky's rockylinux/rockylinux:8 repository on
# 2026-11-05, Alma's php:8.1) except the made-up contexts 0a1b2c3d and aaaaaaaa. Shared byte for byte with meshTerm's copy. Format: a<TAB>b<TAB>expected (-1, 0, 1).
